# Get-ZbxDashboard

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the dashboards of the Zabbix frontend.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxDashboard [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-Id <ulong[]>] [-SelectUsers] [-SelectUserGroups] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByName

```
Get-ZbxDashboard [-Name] <string[]> [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-SelectUsers] [-SelectUserGroups] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ById

```
Get-ZbxDashboard [-SortField <string[]>] -Id <ulong[]> [-SelectUsers] [-SelectUserGroups] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByFilter

```
Get-ZbxDashboard [-SortField <string[]>] -Filter <ZabbixDashboardGetParameters> [-SelectUsers] [-SelectUserGroups] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A dashboard is a page of widgets in the Zabbix frontend, such as graphs, problem lists and maps, shared with users and user groups. The Get-ZbxDashboard cmdlet reads them with dashboard.get: all of them up to -Limit, by name with -Name (* and ? are wildcards), by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole dashboard.get selection in -Filter. It writes ZabbixDashboard objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get a dashboard by name

```powershell
Get-ZbxDashboard -Name 'Ops overview'
```

Gets the dashboard named Ops overview. A * or ? in -Name makes it a search, so -Name 'Ops*' gets every dashboard whose name starts with Ops.

### Example 2: Search dashboards with a filter

```powershell
Get-ZbxDashboard -Filter @{ search = @{ name = 'Ops' }; limit = 10 }
```

-Filter takes the whole dashboard.get selection, keyed by the API's field names: here at most ten dashboards whose name contains Ops.
